question: Which statement best describes Receive the DOM node?
options: React calls a callback ref with the attached DOM element. When that element is removed, React signals that it is no longer attached. This lets a component set up work at the right moment. It is like receiving a key only when a room is ready to use.

An effect can attach an observer or browser listener after rendering and clean it up when dependencies change or the component unmounts. Keep the observer instance associated with the element it watches. Cleanup prevents stale callbacks from updating a page that no longer exists.

ResizeObserver reports when an element’s size changes. Attach it when the node is available and disconnect it when the node is removed. This is more reliable than repeatedly checking dimensions on a timer. It is like a door sensor that signals when the room changes.

`getBoundingClientRect()` returns the element’s current size and position. The result can become outdated after content, fonts, or viewport changes. Do not measure during render; update after the browser has laid out the page. A ruler gives one measurement, not a promise about tomorrow.
explanation: React calls a callback ref with the attached DOM element. When that element is removed, React signals that it is no longer attached. This lets a component set up work at the right moment. It is like receiving a key only when a room is ready to use.
